high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42.com, titled "30 Startups To Watch: Startup...," delivered by Google. The article discusses Kusho, a startup founded in 2023 by BITS Pilani alumni Abhishek Saikia and Sourabh Gawande. The startup focuses on developing AI agents that utilize the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) to ensure code testing during development and with every new release.
